quotes.quote: Contributions presented to the journal can be research papers, short notes, surveys, and possibly research problems.

quotes.what: article type for a long paper
quotes.quote: Contribution - Full length original research article of more than 10 pages.

quotes.what: article type for a short paper
quotes.quote: Note - A short self-contained original research article of 10 pages or less

quotes.what: Communications go through a board member
quotes.quote: Please note that Communications should be sent directly to a member of the Editorial Board chosen by the author.
You are recommended to use the Elsevier article class elsarticle.cls to prepare your manuscript and BibTeX to generate your bibliography.

quotes.what: first submission may be a single PDF
quotes.quote: You may choose to submit your manuscript as a single Word or PDF file to be used in the refereeing process.
Editable files (e.g., Word, LaTeX) are required to typeset your article for final publication.

quotes.what: a preprint is not prior publication
quotes.quote: Sharing your preprints e.g. on a preprint server will not count as prior publication
that it is not under consideration for publication elsewhere
Supports open access
include 3 to 5 bullet points (maximum 85 characters, including spaces, per bullet point)

quotes.what: AI in writing, 2024 wording (stricter than the live policy)
quotes.quote: authors should only use these technologies to improve readability and language
by adding a statement at the end of their manuscript in the core manuscript file, before the References list
Policy updated June 2026.

quotes.what: drafting is allowed, substitution is not
quotes.quote: AI tools may support drafting or improving clarity, but they must not replace your intellectual contribution.

quotes.what: AI in the research process goes in Methods
quotes.quote: Where AI tools are used as part of the research process rather than manuscript preparation, this use should be described in detail in the Methods section.
Authors should disclose the use of AI tools for manuscript preparation in a separate AI declaration statement included in their manuscript upon submission.
Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the manuscript preparation process
This may include retaining logs provided by the tool, saving prompts and generated outputs

quotes.what: the subscription route is free in a hybrid journal
quotes.quote: Authors publishing in hybrid journals can publish under the subscription model at no cost
fees range between approximately $200 and $11,400 US Dollars, excluding tax

unverified.why: sciencedirect.com answers 403 to this host (dump kept); the 2024-01-08 archive copy is used, dated

unverified.item: the APC of Discrete Applied Mathematics itself
unverified.why: shown only on sciencedirect.com and in Elsevier's APC list, neither reachable; only the Elsevier-wide range is quoted

unverified.item: a limit on the number of submissions, or a rule on resubmission after rejection
unverified.why: the 2024 guide says nothing on either (searched for resubmi, appeal, rejected); the live page could not be read

reading.article_type: Contribution (more than 10 pages); a 12-18 page paper is a Contribution, not a Note or a Communication
reading.format: elsarticle and BibTeX recommended; a single PDF suffices at first submission, editable sources at revision
reading.preprints: the two Zenodo preprints do not count as prior publication
reading.fees: hybrid journal: the subscription route costs nothing; the journal's own APC is UNVERIFIED
reading.ai: the live policy (June 2026) allows AI support in drafting but not as a substitute for the authors' contribution, asks for a declaration section, and puts AI used in the research itself into Methods; the 2024 guide's 'only readability and language' is older and stricter, and the paper follows the live policy while saying plainly what the tools did
